zone:brackenv.name: Brackenvale
zone:brackenv.story: Three fronts trouble a gentle vale. The dead are rising, and that is the main thread through the zone. Frogmen raid the coast and have already destroyed a village. A bandit gang in several camps preys on the Ashbys and on Riverwatch.
fronts: frogmen (amphen) incursion along the coast, a village destroyed
bandits in several camps, plaguing the Ashby farm and Riverwatch
zone:brackenv.note: Camps in layout.json were sketched before the story; rework them to fit the fronts.
zone:brackenv.undead: Several barrows across Brackenvale, raised by a rogue necromancer. At the end of the local chain we learn the necromancer is not alone: they belong to an underground cult in Thornwood.
zone:brackenv.frogmen: The frogmen destroyed a second coastal village, now a ruin. Saltwick is under attack and holding out.
zone:brackenv.bandits: Human bandits, a new creature set to make with the make-creature skill: at least a melee bandit, an archer and a leader, levels about 4 to 10.
zone:brackenv.mine: Kobold side story. Their mine broke into the side of a barrow, and now they are fighting the undead inside it. The necromancer is not directly involved: his rituals passively animate the dead within range, and this barrow is in range without his knowing it.
zone:brackenv.necromancer: A rogue necromancer, he, performing rituals that passively animate the dead near him. Part of an underground cult in Thornwood, which the end of the local chain reveals.

zone:thornwoo.name: Thornwood
zone:thornwoo.story: An underground necromancer cult works in Thornwood, and the zone has an internal conflict of its own, still to be decided.
zone:thornwoo.hook: Brackenvale's undead chain ends by pointing here.

camp:cmptower.name: The broken tower
camp:cmptower.purpose: The rogue necromancer's lair, where he performs the rituals that raise the barrows' dead. End of the undead chain.
camp:cmptower.mood: a ruin brooding over the vale from a knoll in a string of hills
